threads.body: [General] This only caps the reusable image workflow, while several image-build jobs covered by the PR's stated scope still retain GitHub's 360-minute default: `pr-/publish-smoke-test-{fake-backend,early-jdk8}-images.yml`, `publish-smoke-test-servlet-images.yml`, and `publish-petclinic-benchmark-image.yml`. A hang in any of those jobs still incurs the cost this PR is intended to prevent; please add job-level timeouts to their build/publish jobs as well.
threads.hunk:
@@ -30,6 +30,7 @@ permissions:
 jobs:
   build:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 60

replies.body:
Good catch. Added in 1a204f52e28e95b8f4b8fbbc847503d50aabc224: `pr-/publish-smoke-test-{fake-backend,early-jdk8}-images.yml` (60), `publish-smoke-test-servlet-images.yml` (`prepare` 10, `publish` 90 for the 13-cell Windows+Linux matrix), `publish-petclinic-benchmark-image.yml` (60), and the `publish-snapshots` job in `build-daily.yml` (60), which is a Gradle build in the same path.

The remaining jobs without a timeout are bot/automation/release-tooling workflows (issue labelling, renovate helpers, release prep, gh-aw agents); I've left those out as outside this PR's scope.
